$comment: Contract for the cooksy MCP server (api/mcp-server.mjs). One tool = one cooksy-api route. Gated tools NEVER write: they store a pending approval and return approval_required. Approve/Deny are not tools; they are HTTP routes only the browser calls.

tools.name: pantry_list
tools.description: List pantry items, optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: pantry_update
tools.description: Add a pantry item or change its quantity. Needs approval.

tools.name: pantry_remove
tools.description: Remove a pantry item. Needs approval.

tools.name: recipes_search
tools.description: Search TheMealDB by dish name, main ingredient or category.

tools.name: recipes_get
tools.description: Full recipe by TheMealDB id: ingredients with measures, steps, category, area. No cooking time or calories exist in this data.

tools.name: plan_view
tools.description: The meal plan for a date range (default: the current week).

tools.name: plan_set_meal
tools.description: Put a recipe on a date and meal. Needs approval.

tools.name: plan_clear_day
tools.description: Clear all meals on one date. Needs approval.

tools.name: shopping_build
tools.description: Rebuild the list from the plan minus the pantry. Needs approval.

tools.name: shopping_export
tools.description: Write the list to a text file in the Cooksy data folder. Needs approval. Sends nothing to anyone.

browserOnlyRoutes: POST /approvals/:id/approve   (atomic pending->executing->executed; the server runs the stored action itself)
